limits: Conditional and temporary, for development only: the Debian findings of the assessed image, at these exact versions. It authorizes no staging or production deployment. A critical finding enters this list only by its own decision of the Owner. TASK-013 reassesses curl and libcurl before its HTTP or S3 integration; gate RELEASE reviews every remaining vulnerability independently.

accepted.debianStatus: trixie vulnerable, <no-dsa> (Minor issue); fixed upstream in 8.14.2 and 8.21.0

critical.scanSeverityFrom: CISA-ADP CVSS 3.1 9.8; the curl project publishes no CVSS
critical.upstreamSeverity: curl.se: Low; libcurl only, not the command-line tool
critical.knownExploited: No KEV entry; CISA SSVC exploitation poc, automatable yes (record of 2026-07-06)
critical.needs: CURLOPT_STREAM_DEPENDS or CURLOPT_STREAM_DEPENDS_E, then curl_easy_reset and curl_easy_cleanup
critical.exposure: Not reachable: nothing in the image sets HTTP/2 stream dependencies, and the application makes no libcurl request at this revision

accepted.rationale: A use-after-free at a handle's cleanup, needing HTTP/2 stream dependencies that the curl project calls extremely rarely used.
accepted.mitigation: The application calls neither libcurl nor its HTTP client; the only curl in use is the health check's fixed loopback request.
accepted.reviewTrigger: TASK-013 before its HTTP or S3 integration: check that its client sets no stream dependency.

accepted.debianStatus: trixie vulnerable, <no-dsa> (Minor issue); fixed upstream in 8.14.2 and 8.21.0

critical.scanSeverityFrom: CISA-ADP CVSS 3.1 9.8; the curl project publishes no CVSS
critical.upstreamSeverity: curl.se: Medium; libcurl only, not the command-line tool
critical.knownExploited: No KEV entry; CISA SSVC exploitation poc, automatable yes (record of 2026-07-06)
critical.needs: One libcurl handle reused from a Digest-authenticated transfer to a second origin
critical.exposure: Not reachable: no Digest authentication is configured anywhere, and the application makes no libcurl request at this revision

accepted.rationale: Sends one Digest Authorization header to a second origin when a handle is reused; a malicious second host could repeat that single request.
accepted.mitigation: No Digest authentication and no outbound request from the application at this revision.
accepted.reviewTrigger: TASK-013 before its HTTP or S3 integration: its store uses signed requests, and its pings use no Digest authentication.

critical.needs: CURLMOPT_PUSHFUNCTION, CURL_LOCK_DATA_CONNECT, HTTPS over HTTP/2 and a pushed stream that the application accepts, all at once
critical.exposure: Not reachable: nothing in the image enables HTTP/2 Server Push, and the application makes no libcurl request at this revision

critical.needs: Negotiate authentication with blank credentials, and a second request reusing that connection
critical.exposure: Not reachable: no Negotiate authentication is configured; the health check's one request sends no credentials and no second user exists

accepted.reviewTrigger: TASK-013 before its HTTP or S3 integration: check that its client uses no Negotiate authentication.

accepted.debianStatus: trixie vulnerable, <no-dsa> (Minor issue); fixed in unstable 2.14.5; no trixie-backports package

critical.scanSeverityFrom: The scanner's Critical; the CNA (Canonical) gives CVSS 4.0 7.0, High
critical.upstreamSeverity: Canonical, as CNA: High, attack complexity High
critical.knownExploited: No KEV entry; CISA SSVC exploitation none, automatable no (record of 2026-06-22); the CNA's vector states E:P, a proof of concept
critical.needs: PHP parsing attacker-supplied XML with faulty entity resolution in its internal subset
critical.exposure: Not reachable: the application parses no XML. Its requests are JSON, forms and multipart; images go through GD, which does not use libxml2; no code of app/ calls an XML parser, and no vendor path that parses XML runs on input from a request

accepted.rationale: A use-after-free in xmlParseInternalSubset; the remote denial of service needs a parser run on crafted XML.
accepted.mitigation: No XML input exists in any route, command or upload; SVG and other XML formats are refused by the media pipeline.
accepted.reviewTrigger: Any Task that accepts or parses XML, an XML-based file format or an import through libxml2.

critical.needs: A libcurl handle told to clear its proxy credentials, then used for a later transfer

accepted.debianStatus: trixie vulnerable, <no-dsa> (Minor issue); fixed in unstable 2.42.3
accepted.rationale: mount runs post-mount hooks without checking its helper's result, a local privilege escalation that needs a local unprivileged user.
accepted.mitigation: The processes run as www-data and start no mount; no route reaches a shell or an external program with user input.
accepted.reviewTrigger: Gate TARGET's hardening of the container; any Task that starts an external mount or gives the container mount rights.

accepted.debianStatus: trixie vulnerable, <no-dsa> (Minor issue); fixed in unstable 2.42.4
accepted.rationale: nsenter --join-cgroup keeps a root-opened descriptor across namespace changes; needs root running nsenter against an attacker's target.
accepted.mitigation: Nothing in the image runs nsenter, and its processes are not root.
accepted.reviewTrigger: Gate TARGET's hardening of the container; any Task that runs nsenter.
